score_reason: Concrete product launch from a major design platform, but one outlet and company claims only.
headline: Figma has launched a markdown tool that lets design teams write down their brand rules so AI agents follow them.
importance_line: Design teams and the AI agents they use get a shared rulebook for on-brand work, though whether agents follow it reliably is untested.
summary: TechCrunch reports that Figma, the design software company, unveiled Figma Specs at its first Config event in India: a markdown editor where teams write down their design language so that Figma's own and third-party AI agents can follow it. Figma also moved its code layers feature from private to public beta and added support for more than 20 new tools through MCP, a standard for connecting AI tools; the company says the aim is to make agents' output less unpredictable.
